findings_to_judge.finding: The US$10m buyback that drove the stock +21.5% on 2026-09-03 and anchored the +76% five-session run is 17 Education's sixth consecutive annual US$10m authorisation (Nov 2021, Sep 2022, Sep 2023, Sep 2024, Sep 2025, Sep 2026) and is a straight rollover of the identical US$10m program that ran 2025-09-04 to 2026-09-04 and expired four days before this one started.

Q1 2026's headline RMB99.5m revenue (+359% YoY) was drawn largely out of a one-off pre-sale balance rather than new demand: deferred revenue and advances from customers fell from RMB165.9m at 2025-12-31 to RMB104.5m at 2026-03-31, a RMB61.5m drawdown equal to 62% of the quarter's revenue, and cash plus term deposits fell RMB54.6m (RMB406.9m to RMB352.3m) against a reported net loss of only RMB19.4m - 2.8x the loss.

The company dismissed Deloitte Touche Tohmatsu as its auditor effective 2026-05-27 and appointed Marcum Asia CPAs LLP for the year ending 2026-12-31 - i.e. it dropped a Big Four auditor two quarters after its revenue recognition profile changed beyond recognition, and the Q2 2026 numbers about to be released are the first reported under the new firm.

Deferred revenue and advances from customers fell from RMB165.9m at 31-Dec-2025 to RMB104.5m at 31-Mar-2026, so RMB61.4m of the RMB99.5m of Q1 revenue that produced the headline '+359% YoY' was a drawdown of Q4 2025 pre-sale orders: implied new billings were only about RMB38m, less than the RMB43.2m spent on sales and marketing in the same quarter, and cash plus restricted cash plus term deposits fell RMB54.6m (RMB407.0m to RMB352.4m) against a reported net loss of just RMB19.4m.

The US$10 million buyback authorisation announced 2026-09-03 that triggered the +21.5% jump is at least the fourth identical US$10 million 12-month authorisation the company has issued (November 2021, September 2024, September 2025, September 2026), and the FY2024 20-F discloses that only approximately US$0.1 million had actually been repurchased under the September 2024 programme as of 31-Dec-2024 — about 1% of the authorisation.

The CEO's near-daily Form 4 open-market ADS purchases through August and early September — reported by aggregators as conviction buying — are executions of a Rule 10b5-1 trading plan entered into on 2026-03-31 with Tiger Brokers (NZ) Limited covering 30-Jun-2026 to 31-Mar-2028, a fact disclosed for the first time in Item 6 of a Schedule 13D/A filed on the morning of the print itself.

Deloitte Touche Tohmatsu was dismissed as auditor effective 2026-05-27 — four weeks after signing the FY2025 20-F and three weeks before the Q1 revenue inflection was reported — and replaced by Marcum Asia CPAs LLP, a firm the PCAOB censured and fined US$100,000 on 2025-09-23.

There is a real structural bid under the stock that cuts against the fade: the CEO's 10b5-1 plan runs to 31-Mar-2028 and the US$10m authorisation is live, against a non-Liu share base of only about 6.4m ADS-equivalent (542.2m shares outstanding less Andy Chang Liu's 223.9m / 41.30%) and a pre-spike median volume of 4,600 ADSs a day.
